fireside.speaker: Ivy
fireside.text: "272 wood. We need 350. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Sari
fireside.text: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Palisade on empty shelves — 8,050 of 14,000 kcal."

fireside.speaker: Adaeze
fireside.text: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Palisade on empty shelves — 7,820 of 14,000 kcal."

fireside.speaker: Sari
fireside.text: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Palisade on empty shelves — 10,082 of 14,000 kcal."

fireside.speaker: Jasper
fireside.text: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

fireside.speaker: Omar
fireside.text: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

fireside.speaker: Sari
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table II — 3 people, 29 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 5 plants — 5 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the southwest ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table II's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

The southwest ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table II isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)

The Red Table II's speaker sent a runner: the southwest ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Pasquale speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

🌙 Raid — The Red Table II came in the night from the southwest. They carried off ~1500 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table III. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Daniel's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
